name: Mayon
notes: Stratovolcano; its south-east side meets the sea.

name: Mount Taranaki
notes: Stratovolcano; the Pouakai and Kaitake ranges stand on its north-west side.

name: Shishaldin
notes: Stratovolcano; the coast is within 15 km on two sides.

name: Kilimanjaro (Kibo)
notes: Stratovolcano with a summit caldera; Mawenzi stands 11 km east of Kibo.

name: Mount Etna
notes: Stratovolcano; the Valle del Bove cuts its east flank and the sea is 20 km east.

name: Mauna Kea
notes: Shield volcano (above sea level only); Mauna Loa rises to its south.

name: Piton de la Fournaise
notes: Shield volcano inside the Enclos Fouque caldera; the sea is 10 km east.

name: Crater Lake (Mount Mazama)
notes: Caldera; the lake surface (about 1883 m) is read as ground.

name: Grand Canyon (Phantom Ranch)
notes: River canyon cut by the Colorado River; its rims stand at different heights.

name: Black Canyon of the Gunnison
notes: River gorge cut in hard crystalline rock.

name: Hells Canyon
notes: River canyon cut by the Snake River.

name: Rhine Gorge (Loreley)
notes: River gorge; the river surface is read as ground.
